sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release

system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu if you have at least 2 or more Starlight’s active. When you cast this jutsu, all Starlight’s, grow in size, filling a 10-foot cube, centered on their original point. But they also now interconnect by beams of plasma. All active Starlight’s, have a 5-foot wide and up to 120-foot-long line of plasma connecting it to other Starlight’s. All Starlight’s, must have a line drawn from it to another Starlight. Hostile creatures that pass through this line for the first time on their turns, or being their turn in one of these lines, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage, being marked as a Convergence for the duration, and are Blinded.

A blinded creature makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the Blinded effect on them on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
